description: List jobs (work orders, estimates, invoices), 30 per page, filterable by schedule window, status, assigned employee, category (job type) or job status. Kickserv: GET /{account}/jobs.xml.

employee_number.description: Only jobs assigned to this employee number.

include.description: Related data to embed: customer, employees, job_charges, time_entries, notes, job_type, job_status, tax_entity, custom_field_assignments.

job_status_id.description: Only jobs with this custom job status id.

job_type_id.description: Only jobs in this category (job type id).

only.description: Comma-separated list of columns to return, e.g. `customer_number,name`. Kickserv recommends this: it makes responses much smaller and faster.

page.description: Page number (Kickserv returns 30 records per page). Omit for page 1.

scheduled.description: Scheduled-date window, e.g. today or this_week.

name: kickserv_list_jobs
title: List jobs
